item.title: CBSB: Mississippi State, Ole Miss sweep opponents as Southern Miss backdoors opening series
item.description: Opening weekend proved solid for Mississippi State, Ole Miss, and Southern Miss, with the Bulldogs and Rebels earning clean sweeps, while the Golden Eagles backdoored a solid opponent. item.title: 4 tornadoes touched down in Mississippi over the weekend
item.description: The National Weather Service has confirmed that at least four tornadoes touched down in Mississippi over the weekend. Each tornado was reported to be rated EF-1, with all four being recorded in the southern region of the state on Saturday night and Sunday morning. The first tornado was reported in Norfield on Saturday at 11:46 […]

item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 2/16/2026
item.description: Head USM baseball coach Christian Ostrander recaps weekend series win over UC Santa Barbara and looks ahead to Tuesday game against Southeastern Louisiana in Hammond, LA and this weekend’s 2026 Round Rock Classic in Round Rock, Texas.

item.title: Mississippi magician sentenced to 10 years in prison for casino scams
item.description: A Mississippi magician will spend a decade behind bars for casino fraud. Shaun Benward, who went by the alias “Shaun Mistery,” will serve multiple sentences adding up to 10 years on felony charges of money laundering, cheating at gambling games, and conspiracy. item.title: Mississippi soldier identified as victim of Valentine’s Day double homicide
item.description: A Mississippi soldier has been identified as a victim of a double homicide on Valentine’s Day. Hamilton native Matthew Wade, 28, was reportedly shot and killed alongside Kateryna Tovmash in North Carolina on Saturday morning. item.description: Mississippi State’s Kappa Sigma fraternity has sponsored the Charity Bowl, a full contact full pads football game between two Greek organizations for nearly 30 years, and have done an outstanding job raising money for the less fortunate. item.title: T&L Extra: Coach Brian O’Connor Joins SportsTalk Mississippi to Recap Opening Weekend
item.description: Mississippi State fans filled Dudy Noble this weekend for the first three games of the Brian O’Connor era. The Diamond Dawg skipper joined Brian Hadad on Monday’s SportsTalk Mississippi to recap his team’s sweep of Hofstra and what he learned about his squad.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: What We Learned About Mississippi State After Opening Weekend
item.description: It was only three games against less than stellar competition, but Mississippi State fans want to know what we learned about the Bulldogs after Opening Weekend. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk discuss their early opinions on the Diamond Dawgs, and hear from Coach Brian O’Connor to get his thoughts on his squad.
